answer: Duplicate identities fail because the token registry rejects reuse, and forging beacons requires holding real stake. Each agent must lock a unique onyx token as stake and broadcast a signed beacon every epoch to prove liveness. Attackers must acquire and lock scarce tokens per fake identity, making sock-puppet costs linear and expensive. Legitimate agents earn rewards from a shared oasis pool, funded by slashed stakes of proven sybils, so cheating subsidizes the honest majority. From sa0016's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
